sandbachFocus: Sandbach United suffered a disappointing 1-3 defeat to New Mills on Tuesday evening, with goals from Tetlow, Morris, and Page proving decisive. The Bach created chances throughout but squandered opportunities and conceded set-piece goals, with an awkward bounce leading to the third goal. Manager JKD reflected on a 'barren landscape' performance, but the team will look to bounce back when they face Ashby Ivanhoe in the FA Vase on Saturday at home, 3pm kick-off, calling for supporter backing 'on mass' for this cup tie.
divisionWide: At the top, Wolverhampton Casuals' unbeaten start ended with a 1-2 midweek defeat at Eccleshall, where Max Chimenes and Morgan Russell goals proved enough despite Kieran Cook's response; Casuals remain joint-second on points but with a game in hand. Eccleshall bounced back emphatically from Saturday's loss to Stafford with that win over the league leaders. Stafford Town put on an impressive display in their 50th anniversary preparations, hammering Alsager 3-2 on Tuesday despite going down to 10 men early in the second half, with goals from Lynch, Mazurkiewicz, and Greer; they face Abbey Hulton in Saturday's FA Vase. Telford Town moved to 4 points after Tuesday's 3-2 comeback win over Alsager, with Brown, Anani and Dawes scoring. New Mills sits top after their midweek victory at Sandbach and face Northwich Victoria in Saturday's FA Vase. Shawbury United recovered from Saturday's loss with a 4-3 away win at Allscott Heath on Tuesday in a seven-goal thriller. AFC Bridgnorth drew 1-1 at Wednesfield to remain unbeaten with 7 points from 3 games, maintaining strong form ahead of Saturday's league match against Crewe. Market Drayton Town won their local derby 1-0 at home to Telford on Tuesday (Cian McIntosh goal) and face Studley in Saturday's FA Vase. Cheadle Heath Nomads welcome Wythenshawe Town to their stadium for FA Vase action. Multiple clubs are now in cup action across the weekend, with several FA Vase ties featuring lower-league opposition.
